- CloudMesh sees Marketplace listing and deployment automation as highest priority (go-live target: Q4).
- Primary integration points: model packaging, onboarding flow for customers, SaaS-to-marketplace billing handshake.
- Security: need to confirm SSO options and customer data flows for the Private deployment path.

Proposed next meeting (60–75 min): technical deep-dive + two demos (partner provisioning + Redwood listing process). Please pick any of the slots below in PT:
- Thu 27 Aug, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 27 Aug, 15:00–16:15 PT
- Mon 31 Aug, 09:00–10:15 PT
